name: Parmesan Chicken
description: A crispy Parmesan-crusted chicken dish baked with spaghetti sauce and mozzarella cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Mix Parmesan cheese with bread crumbs and set aside.
Mix eggs, salt, and pepper.
Dip boneless chicken breasts in egg mixture, then coat with bread crumb mixture.
Arrange coated chicken breasts in a baking dish.
Cover with tinfoil and bake at 350°F for 45 minutes.
Pour spaghetti sauce over the chicken and continue baking.
Before serving, sprinkle grated mozzarella cheese on top and bake for an additional 10 minutes until browned.

keywords: Parmesan chicken, breaded chicken, Italian-American cuisine

_similar.name: Veal Parmigiana
_similar.description: Crispy breaded veal cutlets topped with a homemade quick tomato sauce and melted mozzarella cheese.
recipeIngredient: 1½ lb veal cutlets, ¼ inch thick
1 egg, beaten slightly with 2 to 3 tsp milk
¾ cup sifted dry bread crumbs
¾ cup fresh grated Parmesan cheese
½ to ¾ cup butter for frying
1 large can (16 oz) Italian crushed tomatoes
1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese for topping

recipeInstructions.text: Prepare breading station: In one bowl, mix egg and milk. In another, combine bread crumbs and Parmesan cheese.
Pound veal cutlets until thin, then coat in flour, dip in egg mixture, and finally coat with bread crumb mixture. Let sit for 15 minutes.
Melt butter in a frying pan and sauté veal over low heat until cooked through, flipping carefully.
Combine crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, onion, sugar, and salt in a pot. Bring to a boil, then simmer gently for 15 to 20 minutes to make the quick tomato sauce.
Place cooked veal in a baking pan, pour tomato sauce over the top, and sprinkle with shredded mozzarella cheese.
Bake in a preheated 400°F oven until the cheese is melted and bubbly.

_similar.keywords: veal parmesan, breaded veal, Italian-American, tomato sauce

_similar.name: Chicken Breast
_similar.description: A simple breaded chicken breast recipe.

recipeInstructions.text: Wash chicken breast.
Sprinkle with garlic powder, salt, and seasoning.
Dip in milk, then egg mixture, then bread crumbs.
Bake in a 9x13 inch pan at 350°F until golden.
Serve with rice or noodles.

_similar.name: Boneless Chicken Breasts
_similar.description: A stuffed boneless chicken breast recipe with ham, cheese, and onions.

recipeInstructions.text: Pound chicken with a frying pan or mallet, skin side down.
Layer with ham, cheese, and onions.
Roll up and dip in egg mixture, then coat with bread crumbs.
Put in a cake or casserole pan and bake at 350°F for 1/2 hour or until chicken is cooked.
Combine cottage cheese and Parmesan cheese in a bowl.
Spread 1½ cups of spaghetti sauce in the bottom of a 13x9x2 inch pan.
Arrange a layer of uncooked lasagna noodles on top of the sauce, overlapping slightly.
Sprinkle half of the mozzarella cheese and half of the cottage cheese mixture over the noodles.
Repeat with another layer of sauce, noodles, and the remaining cheeses.
Cover the top with sauce and cover tightly with heavy foil.
Set on a jelly roll pan and bake.

_similar.name: Jelly Roll Style Meat Loaf
_similar.description: A creative meat loaf recipe shaped like a jelly roll, filled with mozzarella cheese and baked in a loaf pan.
recipeIngredient: ½ cup cracker crumbs or dry bread crumbs

recipeInstructions.text: Mix all ingredients except ground beef in a large bowl, using only 1 cup of mozzarella cheese.
Add ground beef and mix thoroughly with hands until just combined.
Shape the mixture into a 10x12 inch rectangle on waxed paper.
Sprinkle 2 cups of mozzarella cheese over the meat.
Roll up the mixture like a jelly roll using the waxed paper and press ends together to seal.
Place the foil-wrapped jelly roll in a meat loaf pan and bake in a 350°F oven for 1 hour.
Drain off fat and pour reserved tomato sauce on the roll.
Bake for an additional 15 minutes.
Let stand for 10 to 15 minutes before slicing.
Decorate with tomato slices and green parsley on a serving tray.

_similar.keywords: meat loaf, jelly roll, mozzarella cheese, baked
